svg.text: Quiet playback, thoughtful defaults, and recovery that keeps people moving.
Photo-led playback with a single control hierarchy
Keep context and offer a clear way back

g.text: Your media stays on your device.
Open the original page to get a fresh link.
Your download is paused, not lost.
Pick up where you left off
We’ll try to resume after the link refreshes.
If the file has changed, a new download starts.
The file may be incomplete or use
a format this player doesn’t support.
Your saved file won’t be removed.

svg.text: The content gets the space; controls get out of the way
No competing play buttons. Chrome fades while watching.
Retain the last frame and playback position; show one spinner.
Lock the screen, keep the moment
Hide touch controls. Press and hold the lock to bring them back.
Recovery is part of the experience.
Explain what happened, preserve context, and show the next useful action.
